verdict.rationale: The documented Gmail REST API, authorized via OAuth with scoped access, covers each step of the story for an external agent. It lets an agent read threads, messages and labels, triage through labels and filters, create drafts and send via drafts.send, and send messages via users.messages.send, with push notifications on mailbox changes. Community reports note that Google restricts third-party OAuth apps, which can complicate connecting consumer agents. Missing for 10: no evidence of a first-party connector or MCP endpoint for Claude/ChatGPT-style agents, no machine-readable agent docs (llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404), and no hands-on corroboration of an agent running the full read-triage-draft-send loop.
